ITA-3.16.42 kūrcaḥ (marma) कूर्चः (मर्म)
Vulnerable location(s) near the wrist and ankle
Four in number (one in each limb) which when injured causes shivering and bending of the limb.

ITA-3.16.53 kūrcaśiraḥ (marma) कूर्चशिरः (मर्म)
Vulnerable location(s) on the wrist and ankle
Four in number (one on each limb) which when injured leads to pain and swelling of the affected part.

ITA-3.13.50 kūrparasandhiḥ. bāhusandhiḥ कू र्परसन्धिः, बाहुसन्धिः
Elbow joint
